correctness.rationale: For the unordered distinct two-point Abrams cubical model of K_m,n, m,n≥3, the degree 0,1,2 oriented chain representations under S_m×S_n are C0=(P_m⊠1)⊕(U_m⊠U_n)⊕(1⊠P_n), C1=(O_m⊠U_n)⊕(U_m⊠O_n), C2=(∧²U_m⊠P_n)⊕(P_m⊠∧²U_n). The two-dimensional matching fibre has exactly two one-dimensional stabilizer sign types, explaining the C2 orientation. Total-motion of two particles gives an equivariant onto map H1→H1(K_m,n); Ko–Park ranks for nonplanar 3-connected graph braid groups imply rational equality, hence H1=V_m⊠V_n. Substituting standard Specht decompositions U=1+V, P=1+V+W, ∧²U=V+Z, O=1+2V+W+Z in Euler–Poincaré yields H2=(W_m⊠Z_n)⊕(Z_m⊠W_n). Semisimplicity justifies representation equality over Q. In square r≥4 both factors irreducible inequivalent and interchange swaps them, forcing full semidirect-product irreducibility and zero trace on exchange coset. At r=3 W3=0 and H2=0. Recomputed dimensions via hook formula: (3,4)=2,(4,4)=12,(4,5)=27,(5,5)=60.
